raw_translation: Chagua faili audio au video, kuchagua pato kuunga mkono na kuchagua kuweka kuanza na kumalizika wakati.
source: Choose an audio or video file, select a supported output and optionally set a start and end time.
translation: Chagua faili audio au video, kuchagua pato kuunga mkono na kuchagua kuweka kuanza na kumalizika wakati.

raw_translation: Chagua faili font, kuingia wahusika mradi wako mahitaji na kuthibitisha kuwa na haki ya kubadilisha font. Pakua subset na kulinganisha usambazaji wake wa tabia na ukubwa wa faili.
source: Choose a font file, enter the characters your project needs and confirm you have the right to modify the font. Download the subset and compare its character coverage and file size.
translation: Chagua faili font, kuingia wahusika mradi wako mahitaji na kuthibitisha kuwa na haki ya kubadilisha font. Pakua subset na kulinganisha usambazaji wake wa tabia na ukubwa wa faili.
